Name: Fleeting Challenge
Author: charodziej
Description:
This is a mod for the Fleeing Farm Challenge by ArgonMatrix.

With this mod, every morning all of your inventory and everything laying on the ground will be deleted and your money will be reset to 0.
Grown crops and items in machines will stay there overnight. Storage like chests, fridges, tables etc will not be emptied, not using them is a gentleman's rule.

The exact rules of the challenge that Argon is following are:
1. Any items in my inventory will be deleted overnight except for tools and weapons. All items lying loose on the ground will also be deleted, including tools and weapons.
2. My money will be reset to 0g every morning immediately after receiving funds from items shipped the previous day.
3. No backpack upgrades and no universal storage options. This includes Chests, Fridges, Tables, Auto-Grabbers, Junimo Huts, and anything other means of unrestricted storage. Restricted storage options such as Fish Tanks and Dressers are allowed.
4. Once I start playing through a day, I cannot reset the day for any reason. Nor can I load a backup save file or use another save file for testing purposes.
5. No glitches, exploits, or strategies that require a predictor. Exceptions may be made in cases where I think they make the challenge more interesting, but most likely not.

Additionally, there is a "money lost" counter, that adds up all the money that has been wasted when items are deleted or thrown into the trash. If you don't like it, you can disable it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu.
[/url]
